Mets, Darwinzon Hernández Agree To Three-Year Deal
items.blurb: The Mets are signing free agent reliever Darwinzon Hernández to a three-year, $12MM contract, reports José F. Rivera. The signing is still pending a physical. Hernández returns to the majors after pitching four seasons in Japan. More to come.

items.title: White Sox To Trade Davis Martin, Luis Castillo To Rockies
items.blurb: The White Sox are trading starting pitchers Davis Martin and Luis Castillo to the Rockies, reports Jeff Passan of ESPN. Colorado is sending two prospects the other way. The Rox are absorbing Castillo’s $22.75MM salary for the upcoming season as a means of enticing Chicago to part with Martin.
